description:
[read-only] Hashtag and @mention suggestions for each platform, from the brand's own config: hashtags from its brand profile's hashtag sets (within each platform's limit, skipping ones already in `text`), mentions from its mention contacts written the way each network receives them (`@handle`; on LinkedIn `@[Name](urn:li:organization:…)`). A contact with no account on a platform is not suggested there. Suggestions only: nothing is added to any caption; offer them to the user. Instagram allows 30 hashtags and YouTube 15; publish removes extra ones.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/content/suggest-tags.)

text.description: The caption so far; tags and mentions already in it are not suggested again.

name: suggest_tags
title: Suggest hashtags and @mentions
